column1: carrierFreqIndicates the RAT and frequency of the CSG member cell(s), for which the proximity indication is sent. For E-UTRA and UTRA frequencies, the UE shall set the ARFCN according to a band it previously considered suitable for accessing (one of) the CSG member cell(s), for which the proximity indication is sent.
typeUsed to indicate whether the UE is entering or leaving the proximity of CSG member cell(s).
